simple.summary: מָאן (mâʼn) means a utensil First listed occurrence: Dan 5 2.

definitions.full: H3984. man [ מָאן ] noun masculine Ezra 7:19 vessel, utensil ( מָ(א)ן ᵑ7 , Syriac , so Christian-Palestinian Aramaic, Schulth Lex. 106 ; Old Aramaic מאן , Phoenician מנן ; possibly √ אנה , see Biblical Hebrew II. אנה , compare Lag BN 183 Buhl); — plural, vessels of temple at Jerusalem: emphatic מָאנַיָּא 5:14-15 , 7:19 ; Dan 5:23 ; construct מָאנֵי 5:2 ; 5:3 ; Ezra 6:5 . עמגִלָּה see גלל .
definitions.rootNote: (Aramaic) probably from a root corresponding to 579 in the sense of an inclosure by sides;
